sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — At the reception desk
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Linh is a new student at Bright English Centre. Today she is at the reception desk. The receptionist asks, "What's your name, please?" Linh says, "My name's Linh Tran." "How do you spell your first name?" "It's L-I-N-H." Her surname is easy: T-R-A-N.

Then the receptionist asks, "What's your email address?" Linh says, "It's linh underscore tran ninety-nine at gmail dot com. It's all lower case." The receptionist says, "Sorry, could you spell that again, please?" Linh spells it again, slowly.

Linh's friend is also at the desk. His name is Matthew Kelly. Matthew has a double T, and Kelly has a double L. "Is that K or C?" asks the receptionist. "K," says Matthew. His email address is matt dot kelly at yahoo dot com. "Is that a capital M?" "No, it's all lower case."

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Booking a hotel room
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: How many nights?
Guest name: Emma ____
Home town: ____
Address: 14 ____ Road
What does the receptionist ask her to spell again?
Email: ____
Is the email address all lower case?
Arrival day: ____

sections.audioHint: Nghe 2 lần, điền phiếu đặt phòng.
script: Good afternoon, Lakeside Hotel. How can I help you?
Hi. I'd like to book a room for three nights, please.
Certainly. Can I have your name, please?
How do you spell your surname?
Thank you. And which town are you from?
Sorry, could you spell that again, please?
It's E-M-M-A dot T 8 8 at G-M-A-I-L dot C-O-M.
Perfect. And what day will you arrive?
Great. That's three nights from Friday. See you then, Ms Thornton!
